name: cross_layer_call
description: main.ts directly calling Render layer methods (bypassing EventBus)
source: Section 3.2 Direction 3 — 集成链路强制检查 #4: 跨层调用链路
rationale: Tower Stack 3D architecture violation: main.ts directly calls renderer.render() instead of dispatching via EventBus, creating tight coupling between bootstrap and render layer. EventBus should be the only channel between business logic and rendering.
